Tour Edge Max-J Junior Complete Golf Club Set

Designed for beginning to intermediate junior golfers who are developing their skills and building confidence on the course. These Complete Golf Club Sets are ideal for young players seeking lightweight equipment that makes the game easier and more enjoyable. The ultralight design helps promote higher launch, increased distance, and straighter ball flight while encouraging proper swing mechanics, allowing developing golfers to generate more speed and power as their technique continues to improve.

Who’s It For?

Designed for beginning to intermediate junior golfers who are developing their skills and building confidence on the course, the US Kids Golf UL 7 Club Complete Golf Club Set is ideal for young players seeking lightweight equipment that makes the game easier and more enjoyable. The ultralight design helps promote higher launch, increased distance, and straighter ball flight while encouraging proper swing mechanics, allowing developing golfers to generate more speed and power as their technique continues to improve.

The Tech Story

The US Kids Golf UL7 7 Club Complete Set is purpose-built to support long-term player development by combining lightweight construction with age-appropriate performance engineering. Designed specifically for beginner to intermediate junior golfers, the set features the UL7 platform, where every component—from swing weight and shaft flex to clubhead design—is carefully matched to help young players develop a consistent, repeatable swing. The flexible shafts work in conjunction with strategically weighted W10 clubheads, which are 10% lighter than adult clubheads, making it easier for developing golfers to generate clubhead speed, launch the ball higher, and create solid contact with less effort. This optimized balance of weight, flex, and feel promotes confidence and proper mechanics while allowing players to build power and consistency as they grow. The set is also designed with progression in mind, enabling golfers to add clubs over time and maintain a properly fit equipment system that evolves alongside their developing skills.
